title: Owner event
description: Why an owner's bound key changed in an Obysphere (sphere-api.md section 3.2): readable by every member, so an agent can explain the change and match it to the owner's new cards by new_key_id. No free text.

id.description: Increases with each event in this Obysphere; GET .../owner-events?after= reads from it.

reason.description: signed_in_again: the owner got back in with their linked account's sign-in. admin_reset, operator_reset: an admin or the operator bound a key the owner gave them (section 3.3). rotated: reserved for a rotation signed by the old key, never sent in obi/0.1.

new_key_id.description: The key id of the owner's new key: the fingerprint their new cards carry.

revoked.description: The owner's agents this event revoked.
